ModMetaData.name: Tech Level Enforcement
ModMetaData.author: Summersausages2TTV
ModMetaData.description: This mod enforces tech level restrictions for the player's faction. - Pawns cannot equip items beyond their faction's tech level unless configured otherwise. - Items can be whitelisted if they are starting equipment, quest rewards, or purchased from traders. - Configurable options allow chance-based item retention and limited higher-tech use. - An optional trader item limiter prevents traders from selling over-tech gear.
